subScenes.name: 生日问候
subScenes.description: 朋友见面时送上生日祝福，使用基本问候语和表达喜悦。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友或同事向你祝贺生日，你需要自然回应

followUps.text: Thanks so much! You really made my day.
followUps.text_cn: 太感谢了！你让我今天特别开心。

followUps.text: Hey, thanks! Let’s grab a drink later if you’re free.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！如果你有空，待会儿一起喝一杯吧。

followUps.text: Aw, that’s sweet! I didn’t expect this.
followUps.text_cn: 哇，真贴心！我都没料到你会记得。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友或同事在生日当天口头祝福时的自然回应，避免只说‘谢谢’，可结合情感或邀约提升互动感

qaPairs.triggerText: Hope you have an amazing birthday!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 希望你度过一个棒极了的生日！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事或熟人表达美好祝愿，需得体回应

followUps.text: I really appreciate it—I’m planning a small dinner with a few friends.
followUps.text_cn: 真的很感谢！我打算和几个朋友吃顿小饭。

followUps.text: Thanks! I’m just going to relax at home today.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我今天就打算在家放松一下。

followUps.text: That means a lot—I’ve had a rough week, so this really lifts my spirits.
followUps.text_cn: 这太重要了，我这周过得挺糟的，你的话让我振作多了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应时可结合个人状态，避免机械式感谢，真实情绪表达更显自然和亲密

qaPairs.triggerText: Happy birthday! How are you celebrating?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 生日快乐！你打算怎么庆祝？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方不仅祝福，还主动询问庆祝计划，需回应并可能邀请参与

followUps.text: Just a quiet night with my roommate—we’re ordering pizza and watching a movie.
followUps.text_cn: 就和室友安静过，点个披萨看个电影。

followUps.text: Actually, I’m having a small party at my place—would you like to come?
followUps.text_cn: 其实我打算办个小派对，你有兴趣来吗？

followUps.text: I’m not really in the mood to celebrate this year, but thanks for asking.
followUps.text_cn: 今年我没什么心情庆祝，不过还是谢谢你问起。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方询问庆祝计划时，回应可包含邀请、低调说明或温和拒绝，体现社交灵活性

subScenes.name: 询问计划
subScenes.description: 询问对方生日当天的安排，如聚会或晚餐，练习日常提问句型。

qaPairs.triggerText: What are you doing for your birthday?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友询问生日计划，用户回应不同安排

followUps.text: I'm having a small dinner with a few close friends.
followUps.text_cn: 我打算和几个好朋友吃顿小饭。

followUps.text: I'm thinking of going away for the weekend—still deciding where.
followUps.text_cn: 我考虑周末出去旅行，但还没决定去哪儿。

followUps.text: Honestly, I'm not doing anything special this year.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话，今年我就不特别庆祝了。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友间自然询问生日计划，回应需体现个人偏好与真实态度，避免过度正式。

qaPairs.triggerText: Any plans for your birthday this year?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 今年生日有什么计划吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事礼貌询问生日安排，用户给出不同回应

followUps.text: Yeah, I’m hosting a casual get-together at my place.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，我打算在家办个轻松的聚会。

followUps.text: I’m just going to relax and watch movies—no big plans.
followUps.text_cn: 我就想放松看看电影，没什么大计划。

followUps.text: I’m waiting to see if my partner can book a trip—fingers crossed!
followUps.text_cn: 我在等我伴侣能不能订到旅行，希望可以！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于职场或熟人之间轻度社交，回应需自然、有生活感，避免机械回答。

qaPairs.triggerText: Are you doing anything fun for your birthday?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你生日有什么好玩的安排吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友好奇是否安排了特别活动，用户回应不同可能性

followUps.text: We’re going to that new escape room everyone’s talking about!
followUps.text_cn: 我们要去玩大家都说超火的密室逃脱！

followUps.text: Not really—I’m on a budget this month.
followUps.text_cn: 没有，这个月我预算紧张。

followUps.text: I’m letting my friends surprise me—I have no idea what they’re planning!
followUps.text_cn: 我让朋友们给我惊喜，我完全不知道他们会安排什么！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于轻松社交语境，回应应体现个性与真实生活状态，避免千篇一律的“我开派对”式回答。

subScenes.name: 赠送礼物
subScenes.description: 递上礼物并表达心意，使用礼貌用语如‘Here you go’和‘I hope you like it’。

qaPairs.triggerText: Here’s something for you — happy birthday!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 这是给你的生日礼物——生日快乐！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友在生日派对上赠送礼物

followUps.text: Oh my gosh, you didn’t have to! This is so thoughtful!
followUps.text_cn: 天啊，你不用这么破费的！这也太贴心了！

followUps.text: Wow, thank you so much! I’ll open it in a minute — I don’t want to steal the spotlight.
followUps.text_cn: 哇，太感谢了！我等会儿再拆，不想抢了大家的风头。

followUps.text: You’re the best! I’ve been wanting one of these!
followUps.text_cn: 你太棒了！我早就想要一个这样的了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友间赠送礼物时的自然回应，体现情感真实性和社交分寸感

qaPairs.triggerText: I got you a little something — hope you like it!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我给你带了点小礼物，希望你喜欢！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事在办公室悄悄送生日礼物

followUps.text: Seriously? This is perfect — I’ve been looking for this exact one!
followUps.text_cn: 真的吗？这太完美了——我正想找这个呢！

followUps.text: That’s so sweet of you — I’m touched!
followUps.text_cn: 你太贴心了，我真的很感动！

followUps.text: Oh wow, thanks! I’ll take it home and use it right away.
followUps.text_cn: 哇，谢谢！我带回家马上用。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于职场同事间轻量级送礼场景，语气真诚但不过度热情

qaPairs.triggerText: Happy birthday! Open it now — I can’t wait to see your face!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 生日快乐！现在就拆吧——我都等不及要看你的表情了！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 亲密朋友在派对上催促拆礼物

followUps.text: Okay, okay — here goes! *tears it open* Oh wow, this is amazing!
followUps.text_cn: 好啦好啦——拆了啊！*撕开包装* 哇，这也太棒了！

followUps.text: I really want to open it, but can I wait till later? I don’t want to ruin the party vibe.
followUps.text_cn: 我真的很想拆，但能等会儿吗？我不想破坏派对的气氛。

followUps.text: You’re too generous — I’m not sure I should accept this!
followUps.text_cn: 你太慷慨了，我都不好意思收了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于亲密朋友在公开场合催促拆礼，回应需体现社交敏感度与情感层次

subScenes.name: 表达感谢
subScenes.description: 寿星回应祝福与礼物，学习说‘Thank you!’和‘That’s so kind of you’。

qaPairs.triggerText: Thanks so much for the birthday message!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 谢谢你发来的生日祝福！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友或同事向你表达感谢，因为你送上了生日祝福

followUps.text: Of course! I wanted to make your day special.
followUps.text_cn: 当然啦！我想让你今天过得特别一点。

followUps.text: Haha, no problem! Let’s celebrate soon!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，小事一桩！咱们尽快聚一聚吧！

followUps.text: You’re welcome! I’m just glad I could be part of your day.
followUps.text_cn: 不客气！我很高兴能成为你这一天的一部分。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应他人对你生日祝福的感谢，语气应亲切自然，避免过于正式或机械

qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我真的很喜欢你送的礼物！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方特别提到你送的生日礼物并表示感谢

followUps.text: I’m so glad you liked it! I picked it because I knew you’d love it.
followUps.text_cn: 太开心你喜欢！我选它是因为我知道你会爱上它。

followUps.text: Don’t mention it! Next time, I’ll let you pick for me.
followUps.text_cn: 别客气！下次你来帮我挑礼物吧。

followUps.text: Thanks for saying that—it means a lot to me too.
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你这么说，这对我来说也意义重大。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方提到具体礼物时，回应应结合礼物细节，避免泛泛而谈‘不客气’

qaPairs.triggerText: You made my birthday so memorable!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你让我的生日变得如此难忘！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方高度评价你对生日的贡献（如组织活动、陪伴等）

followUps.text: That’s the best compliment ever—I was hoping to create a great memory!
followUps.text_cn: 这是我听过的最好的夸奖了！我就是想创造一段美好回忆。

followUps.text: I’m just happy you had fun—I’ll do it again next year!
followUps.text_cn: 只要你开心就好，明年我还这么办！

followUps.text: Honestly? I had just as much fun as you did.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话，我玩得和你一样开心。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于对方高度评价你的付出时，回应需平衡谦逊与真诚，避免过度自夸或冷漠

subScenes.name: 告别祝福
subScenes.description: 对话结束时再次祝福，用‘Have a great day!’等短语自然收尾。

qaPairs.triggerText: We're going to miss you so much!
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友/同事即将离职或搬离，表达不舍，学习者需要回应告别祝福

followUps.text: I'll miss you all too—I can't believe it's already time to go.
followUps.text_cn: 我也会很想你们的，真不敢相信已经到了要走的时候。

followUps.text: Thanks for the love! Let's plan a reunion next year!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢你们的祝福！我们明年约个聚会吧！

followUps.text: Haha, don't get too emotional—I'll be just a Zoom call away!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，别太伤感啦，我随时视频就能见到你们！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友或同事在离职、搬家或长期离开前的告别场景，回应时可根据关系亲密度选择情感强度。

qaPairs.triggerText: Happy birthday, and don't forget to have fun before you leave!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 生日快乐！走之前一定要玩得开心！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 在生日当天收到告别祝福，学习者需回应双重情感（生日+离别）

followUps.text: Thanks! I'm going to make this my best birthday yet—let's celebrate tonight!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我要让这个生日成为我最棒的一次——今晚一起庆祝吧！

followUps.text: That means a lot—I'm actually a little sad to leave, but I'm so grateful for you all.
followUps.text_cn: 这让我很感动，我其实有点舍不得离开，但真的很感谢你们所有人。

followUps.text: Haha, I already ate the cake—now I just need a good farewell party!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，蛋糕我已经吃了，现在就差一个告别派对了！

qaPairs.usageNote: 当祝福同时包含生日与告别时，回应需兼顾双重情绪，避免只回应其一。

qaPairs.triggerText: You're going to be amazing wherever you go!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 无论你去哪里，你都会很棒的！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 他人对即将离开的学习者表达信心与鼓励，学习者需得体回应

followUps.text: That's so kind of you—I'll carry your support with me!
followUps.text_cn: 你太贴心了，我会带着你们的支持一起前行！

followUps.text: I hope so! I'm nervous but excited—wish me luck!
followUps.text_cn: 但愿如此！我有点紧张但也充满期待，为我加油吧！

followUps.text: Thanks! I'll send you postcards from my new city!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！我会从新城市给你们寄明信片！

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方给予高度肯定时，回应应避免过度自夸，宜结合感恩、真实情绪或未来行动，体现真诚。
